public.title: Roman to Integer
public.description: roman is a valid canonical uppercase Roman numeral representing 1 to 3999, using I,V,X,L,C,D,M. Return its integer value. Subtractive pairs are IV, IX, XL, XC, CD, CM. Inputs are guaranteed valid; numeral validation is not required.
hints: A smaller symbol before a larger one is subtracted.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Scan symbols, subtracting exactly when the next symbol has larger value. O(n) time and O(1) lookup space.
